justification: Inspected javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/printer/concretesyntaxmodel/CsmList.java and javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/printer/concretesyntaxmodel/CsmElement.java. CsmList is a focused list-formatting helper: 5 fields, 3 constructors, 5 getters, 1 prettyPrint method, and 1 toString, all centered on printing list-like properties. The two-branch prettyPrint only handles NodeList vs Collection values and separator/pre/post handling; I found no separate responsibilities or cohesive subareas that would justify splitting the class.
